Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Beasley
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 205 as introduced could reduce the expenditures of the Secretary of State's Office, paid from the State General Fund, to transmit sets of the Code of Alabama 1975, replacement volumes, or annual supplements to members of the Legislature by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of members that decline, every quadrennium by written request submitted to the Secretary of State to receive code sets, annual supplements and replacement volumes.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Beasley
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 205 as passed the Senate could reduce the expenditures of the Secretary of State's Office, paid from the State General Fund, by $845 for each full set of the Code of Alabama 1975, replacement volumes, or annual supplements declined by certain elected officials.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
